dcterms:description: A dataset used for Chinese sentence segmentation, containing approximately 860,000 segmented Chinese sentences from newspapers and published books, along with a test set of about 22,000 unsegmented sentences.
dcterms:title: Chinese Segmentation Dataset

dcterms:description: A sentiment analysis dataset containing 16,548 sentences with positive sentiment and 18,574 with negative sentiment, sourced from Chinese online shopping, movie, and book reviews, along with additional data crawled from Weibo.
dcterms:title: Sentiment Analysis Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset for troll detection, containing user information and comments from Weibo, including features such as follower count, original posts, and sentiment scores, with a total of 31,980 comments from selected tweets.
dcterms:title: Troll Detection Dataset
